scope: Native upstream neureka_normquant.sv, neureka_normquant_shifter.sv, neureka_normquant_multiplier.sv, and packages. Public baseline is unmodified upstream RTL.

tools.synthesis: Yosys 0.70+286 with Slang frontend and ABC technology mapping to NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib
tools.sta: OpenROAD 26Q2 static timing analysis at 1.75 ns clock period, 0.25 ns I/O delays, 5.0 fF output load

limitations: Cycle-accurate simulation across 600 directed and randomized multi-mode vectors, not unbounded formal equivalence. Nangate45 mapped standard-cell area and OpenSTA static timing, not detailed routing or foundry signoff.
